issues.where: upper right of the glass, above the tree crown (set-F-02 crop 4, set-F-03 crop 7)
issues.what: five or six grey streaks with dark cast shadows sit on the glass. They read as solid twigs or rods lying on the surface, not as water runs or cracks. They have no refraction, no bright leading bead, and no taper
issues.fix: remove them, or replace them with thin clear drip trails that each end in a bright bead and bend the scene behind them slightly. No cast shadow

issues.where: the mirror image below the base, from the contact line to the bottom of the frame (set-E-03 crops 10, 11)
issues.what: the reflection is a straight-sided rectangle as wide as the base that runs to the frame edge with hard vertical sides. The sphere above should reflect as a rounded shape that narrows and fades, not as a column
issues.fix: re-render the reflection from the real geometry so the globe's curve shows below the base, and let the reflection fade and spread with distance

issues.where: the vertical moss face of the base, upper band (set-D-02 crops 2, 3)
issues.what: pale pink and white ovals lie flat on the vertical moss like stickers. They have no stems, no thickness and no contact shadow, and petals could not rest on a vertical face
issues.fix: turn them into small mushroom caps with stems and a contact shadow, or move the petals onto the top of the moss and into the crevices

issues.where: the waterfall on the left of the base (set-F-03 crops 8, 11)
issues.what: the water is a smooth chrome-like ribbon of parallel highlights. It has no translucency, no foam or break-up, it does not darken or wet the stone beside it, and it makes no splash or ripple on the surface
issues.fix: make the stream translucent with broken white water, wet and darken the stone along it, and add a small splash and ripple rings where it lands

issues.where: the waterfall at the left of the base (set-D-02 crops 1, 5)
issues.what: at native size the waterfall reads as glossy grey plastic with smeared, wavy highlight bands and no transparency. It does not wet the stone it runs over
issues.fix: the same fix as in set F: translucent broken water, wet dark stone along its path, and a splash at the foot

issues.where: the collar where the glass meets the moss base (set-F-03 crop 9)
issues.what: the sphere just runs into the top of the moss. There is no seat, no rim of a collar and no thin dark contact line, so the glass looks pasted onto the base
issues.fix: seat the sphere in a collar or a recessed moss lip, and add a thin dark occlusion line and a little moss overlapping the glass

issues.where: the inside of the globe: the cottage, the tree and the ground disc (set-F-02 crops 3, 5)
issues.what: the miniature looks the same as it would with no liquid. It is not enlarged or bent toward the edges, and the front of the ground disc shows as a flat green slab edge cut across the bottom
issues.fix: add refraction from the liquid so the scene is enlarged and bends near the rim, and hide or round off the front edge of the ground disc

issues.where: the pond in front of the cottage (set-F-02 crop 5)
issues.what: the pond is a grey disc stamped with even, hard concentric rings. It reads as a pattern, not water. Apart from the lamp streak it has no depth, no tint and no reflection of the cottage or the tree
issues.fix: give the water dark depth and soft reflections of the cottage, the tree and the lamp, and break up or soften the ripple rings

issues.where: the petals falling inside the globe (set-F-02 crops 1, 6)
issues.what: almost all the petals are equally sharp across the whole depth of the globe. Very few are out of focus in front of or behind the tree
issues.fix: add shallow depth of field so the nearest and farthest petals soften

issues.where: the petals on the surface around the base (set-E-02 crops 1, 4)
issues.what: the petals are flat pink cut-outs of similar size and tone. They have no thickness, no curl and no visible reflection of their own on the glossy surface
issues.fix: vary the size, curl and tone, add a soft contact shadow, and add a faint reflection under each petal

issues.where: the mushrooms at the left and right edges of the base silhouette
issues.what: several mushrooms stick out sideways into the air from the outline of the base. There is no visible attachment or shadow, so they look as if they float
issues.fix: root their stems in the moss with a small contact shadow, and turn the caps upward
